items.context: The Bitcoin Way (@Thebitcoinway_, 17.514 seguidores) publicó un hilo irónico: "Bitcoin on exchange is better than self-custody. Let me explain why holding your #bitcoin on an exchange is safer than holding your own keys (1/7)", y cada una de las 7 partes dice solo "It's not", cerrando con "Any questions?". Defensa humorística de la autocustodia. Post de ~30 min con 5 likes, 2 respuestas y 430 vistas, creciendo.
items.suggested_text:
Seven "it's not"s might be the most efficient custody thread of the year. The pattern behind the joke is real: Mt. Gox in 2014, QuadrigaCX in 2019, FTX in 2022. Different exchanges, same outcome for depositors: a balance they couldn't audit, frozen the day it mattered.

What the joke leaves out is that self-custody moves the risk rather than erasing it. Counterparty risk becomes personal risk: a seed phrase stored badly, a device nobody verified, an inheritance plan no one else can follow.

Holding your own keys is the easy half. Holding them well, for decades, is a different discipline.
